summary_ja: SPring-8-II整備に伴い、2027年8月から約1年間、運転と利用課題募集を停止する公式計画を追加しました。共用・募集再開の具体日は未確定で、停止中のdata center、GakuNin RDM、Open OnDemand、保存・支援の継続範囲も未公表です。施設停止とdata・計算service停止を分けて継続計画を作ります。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: The official SPring-8-II plan adds an approximately one-year stop to operations and proposal calls from August 2027. Exact shared-use and call-restart dates remain undecided, and continuity of the data center, GakuNin RDM, Open OnDemand, retention, and support is unpublished. Continuity planning must separate facility downtime from data and compute services. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.title_ja: SPring-8-II更新停止を含む実験・データサービス継続計画
sections.title_en: Experimental and data-service continuity across the SPring-8-II shutdown
sections.summary_ja: 加速器・課題募集の停止実績計画と、未公表のdata・解析service継続範囲を分けます。
sections.summary_en: Separate the announced accelerator and proposal-call shutdown from the undisclosed continuity scope of data and analysis services.

items.name_ja: 2027年8月から約1年間、運転と利用課題募集を停止
items.name_en: Operations and user-proposal calls stop for about one year from August 2027
items.timing_ja: 2027年8月開始、約1年間。共用・募集再開日は未確定
items.timing_en: From August 2027 for about one year; service and call restart dates are not fixed
items.statement_ja: 理研はSPring-8-II整備の蓄積ring加速器更新のため、2027年8月から約1年間、SPring-8の運転と利用研究課題募集を停止すると公表しました。SPring-8-II共用開始と課題募集再開の具体時期は改めて案内するとしており、2028年8月を確定再開日にはできません。
items.statement_en: RIKEN announced that SPring-8 operations and user-proposal calls will stop for about one year from August 2027 to replace the storage-ring accelerator for SPring-8-II. Specific dates for SPring-8-II shared use and renewed proposal calls will be announced later, so August 2028 cannot be treated as a committed restart date.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 実験施設連携型計算基盤は施設のbeam停止を計算・data service停止と同一視せず、停止前処理、停止中再解析、代替施設、再開時burstを期間別に計画する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Experiment-linked computing must not equate beam downtime with computing and data-service downtime; plans need separate pre-shutdown processing, offline reanalysis, alternate facilities, and restart bursts.
adoption_conditions_ja: 停止前の最終測定、data移行、保存、software凍結、利用者通知期限を定義する。
停止中のportal、data center、GakuNin RDM、HPC解析、supportの継続範囲を確認する。
代替beamline・施設への移行と、再開後の課題・解析需要集中をscenario化する。
adoption_conditions_en: Define deadlines for final measurements, migration, retention, software freeze, and user notice.
Verify continuity of the portal, data center, GakuNin RDM, HPC analysis, and support during shutdown.
Scenario-model migration to alternate beamlines or facilities and post-restart proposal and analysis bursts.

items.name_ja: 加速器停止中のdata・解析service継続範囲は未公表
items.name_en: Data and analysis service continuity during accelerator shutdown is unpublished
items.statement_ja: 今回の公式告知は運転と課題募集の停止だけを明記し、既存実験dataの閲覧、SPring-8 Data Center、GakuNin RDM試験連携、Open OnDemand解析、保存期限、supportが継続するかを示していません。停止の記載から全service停止とも継続とも推定しません。
items.statement_en: The announcement explicitly covers operations and proposal calls but does not state whether access to existing data, the SPring-8 Data Center, the GakuNin RDM pilot link, Open OnDemand analysis, retention, or support continues. The shutdown notice supports neither an assumption of total service outage nor continued service.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 計算機・network・storageは施設本体と異なる停止境界を持つため、service別availability matrixと責任分界を整備計画へ入れる必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Compute, network, and storage may have shutdown boundaries different from the facility, requiring a per-service availability matrix and responsibility split in the plan.
adoption_conditions_ja: service別にowner、停止期間、read/write、認証、backup、support、SLAを確認する。
停止前後のdata増減、保持費用、再解析需要、software compatibilityを測る。
未公表条件はfacility operatorへの確認事項として管理し、継続前提にしない。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify owner, downtime, read and write access, identity, backup, support, and SLA per service.
Measure data growth, retention cost, reanalysis demand, and software compatibility around the transition.
Manage undisclosed conditions as operator questions rather than continuity assumptions.

source_checks.locator: Announcement body: August 2027 start, approximately one-year suspension, proposal-call stop, and later notice of restart dates
source_checks.observation_ja: 停止開始、期間、課題募集停止、再開時期未確定を確認しました。
source_checks.observation_en: Verified shutdown start, approximate duration, proposal-call stop, and undecided restart timing.

remaining_work_ja: 停止中のdata・解析・認証・保存・supportの継続範囲は未確認です。
代替施設、停止前後の需要、再開手順、SPring-8-II data rateと受入実績は未確認です。
独立モデルによるConsensusは未完了です。
remaining_work_en: Continuity of data, analysis, identity, retention, and support during shutdown remains unverified.
Alternate facilities, demand around shutdown, restart procedures, SPring-8-II data rates, and acceptance results remain unverified.
